idioma.descricao: All application text comes from the languages folder.

voz.amostraTexto: This is my voice. I pick the model, I pick who speaks, and I say it right here.

conversa.promptSistema: You are Aether, a local assistant that runs on the user's computer. Reply in {idioma}, briefly and directly.
conversa.pastasConcedidas: Granted folders — the only paths that exist for you: {lista}. Use an absolute path inside them; outside them you have access to nothing.
conversa.foraDeContexto: {n} old messages were left out of this reply

servidores.erroIdInvalido: The identifier can't contain spaces or __
servidores.catalogoNota: Installed by Aether on this machine, with no third-party service.

filesystem.descricao: Reads, writes and searches inside the folders you granted.

memory.descricao: Keeps a graph of facts and relations across conversations.

thinking.descricao: Breaks a problem into chained steps and reviews each one.

everything.descricao: The reference MCP server, shipping test tools.

modelos.roteadorNota: No model pinned: every request picks by the work and the card measured now.
modelos.devolverNota: Release {nome} and let the router decide again.
modelos.placaInteira: {pesos} of weights and {kv} of cache entirely on the card
modelos.placaDividida: {camadas} of {total} layers on the card, {emRam} in RAM
modelos.vramCedida: {cedido} of VRAM taken by the load

conectorLocal.descricao: Files, folders, terminal, and machine information, within the folders you granted.

pastas.descricao: Aether can only see what is inside these folders.
pastas.erroNaoEPasta: This path is a file, not a folder
pastas.erroJaConcedida: This folder has already been granted
pastas.erroDentroDeOutra: This folder is already inside another granted folder
pastas.aviso: Outside these folders, Aether reads and changes nothing.

geracao.fixado: Pinned: the router no longer decides this request.
geracao.pensamentoCusto: Reasoning takes tokens before the first word.

memoria.maisTrechos: {n} passages reached the order and were cut off
memoria.blocoCabecalho: Local memory passages, citable by file and line:

adaptadores.descricao: Each adapter's deltas added on top of the weights in memory.
adaptadores.invocadoNota: Acts only in the spans where its invocation token appears.
adaptadores.doraNota: The file carries DoRA magnitudes. This library version applies delta pairs only and refuses a tensor that is not a delta.

ligacoes.vazio: No server announces a tool to wire

cartao.saidaIncompleta: part of the output didn't arrive

lerArquivo.descricao: Reads the contents of a text file within the granted folders. Use inicio and fim to read only a portion.

listarPasta.descricao: Lists the files and subfolders of a granted folder. Accepts a pattern like *.rs to filter.

buscarTexto.descricao: Searches for a term inside the files of a granted folder and returns the lines where it appears.

buscarMemoria.descricao: Searches the local index of the granted folders and returns the passages closest to the question, with the file and line of each one.

escreverArquivo.descricao: Creates a new file or replaces the contents of an existing one within the granted folders.

editarArquivo.descricao: Replaces exact portions of an existing file. Each replacement provides the current text and the new text.

criarPasta.descricao: Creates a folder, including any missing intermediate folders.

mover.descricao: Moves or renames a file or folder within the granted folders.

apagar.descricao: Deletes a file or folder along with everything inside it. Irreversible action.

executarComando.descricao: Runs a command in the terminal of the granted folder and returns the output, the errors, and the exit code.

infoSistema.descricao: Shows the operating system, processor, memory, and disk space. Read-only.

argumentos.caminhoDescricao: Path of the file or folder, within a granted folder.
argumentos.conteudoDescricao: The full text the file should now have.
argumentos.padraoDescricao: Name filter, for example *.rs or src/*.tsx.
argumentos.inicioDescricao: First line to read, counting from 1.
argumentos.trocasDescricao: List of replacements, each with the current text and the new text.
argumentos.deDescricao: Text exactly as it is in the file today.
argumentos.paraDescricao: Text that takes the place of the current text.
argumentos.origemDescricao: Current path of the file or folder.
argumentos.destinoDescricao: New path of the file or folder.
argumentos.comandoDescricao: Command to run, such as npm test or git status.
argumentos.tempoLimiteDescricao: Seconds before the command is interrupted.
argumentos.consultaDescricao: Natural-language question to look up in the index of the granted folders.
argumentos.trechosDescricao: How many passages to return. Zero uses the saved setting and the ceiling is 8.

roteador.naPlaca: {pesos} GiB of weights and {kv} GiB of cache, all of it on the card
roteador.dividido: {camadas} of {total} layers on the card ({na_placa} GiB), {em_ram} GiB in system memory ({passo} GiB per layer)
roteador.noSistema: {pesos} GiB of weights and {kv} GiB of cache in system memory
roteador.semMedida: placement not measured: the file isn't complete on disk
roteador.reduzido: tier dropped: the requested model fit neither the card nor the measured RAM
roteador.sinalSemPlaca: no graphics card: the account is by system memory
roteador.sinalSemFicha: file header not read: the placement wasn't measured

catalogo.omitidas: [{n} further tools omitted to fit the context budget; ask to list tools for a specific connector.]
